page.content:
Recommendation stack that replaced the front page as the discovery engine.

How YouTube algorithm connects

  • Topic: YouTube — The recommendation algorithm is how most viewers now find YouTube videos.
  • Work: YouTube Shorts — Shorts depend on the same recommender logic, tuned for vertical loops.

What is YouTube algorithm?

The YouTube algorithm — suggested videos, Home, and later Shorts — decides what plays next. Creators treat it as a character: opaque, decisive, and constantly retuned.

Key threads lead to YouTube and YouTube Shorts.
